weather_report:
In the quiet heart of Downtown San Francisco, the night whispers a promise of dawn, though for now, the sky is a blanket of parti-colored clouds softly dimming with the current hour. As the city sleeps, the temperature rests gently around 57 degrees, mingled with a tender west wind that barely stirs the surrounding trees—an invitation for the night owls to wander briefly into the chill of the evening air.

Come Sunday, the sun will rise, transforming the deep folds of gray into striking shades of blue. A serener warmth will grace the day, just shy of 66 degrees, with breezy west-southwest winds rustling through the urban canyons at a lively 6 to 16 mph, bringing with them the scent of the ocean and the distant call of seagulls. The golden rays of sunlight will cast playful shadows across the sidewalks, illuminating hidden corners of the bustling cityscape. Fog layers, typically entwined around the Golden Gate, will retreat to the embrace of the bay, allowing a clear view of the iconic bridge and the vibrant energy of the skyline.

Those planning to roam the picturesque streets should consider layers: a light jacket in the morning, possibly giving way to a simple shirt as the sun finds its zenith. A stroll along the Embarcadero, perhaps to the bustling Ferry Building, where the warm croissants invite a pause, would be ideal. Look towards the waterfront to savor a quiet moment, coffee in hand, as the boats drift lazily across the glimmering bay, framing an enchanting day ahead.
